title: The jinteki run scenarios (runs_test)
blind: The scenario list is the 20 runs_test names in engine #965's PR body. Each scenario's cards and steps were read from jinteki's own test source (test/clj/game/core/runs_test.clj in the upstream reference clone), which is a reference and not an authority (CR 1.2.1). Each outcome was then written from the CR, printed card text and rulings (the lookup skill, with the modelled abilities filtered out); where jinteki asserts something the CR reads differently, the CR's reading is written and the entry says so. The engine's ports of these scenarios (tests/jnet-scenarios/jnet-interactions-*.test.ts), its jnet manifest and its code were not read. Committed before the comparison for this batch existed. What the session had already seen, and does not lean on: #965's PR body, which names the class it gave each scenario (ported or engine bug) and lists its findings on forced encounters; and how the engine played chapter 9 and the rulings sample in this session (Account Siphon with Security Testing, Tollbooth with Inside Job, Ganked! and Konjin forced encounters tripping two invariants, the run that cannot go on after a paid damage interrupt). jinteki plays a subroutine only when the Corp fires it; under the CR an unbroken subroutine resolves, so where a scenario walks past ice the position adds a breaker and says so. Where a scenario uses a test hook in place of a card, the entry names the card used or has no position.
defaults: Unless a case says otherwise: the Runner has the default 4 MU and no link, both identities are blank, servers have no ice, the Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5, the Runner has 4 clicks and the Corp 3 at the start of their turn, zones not mentioned hold only cards with no relevant abilities, neither player spends credits on a trace, the Runner trashes no accessed card, and the Corp declines to rez or use anything not listed in the steps. 'accessed' lists every card accessed during the steps, in order.

cases.position: Runner's turn. An unrezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting R&D, whose top card is Hedge Fund. Corroder is installed. The Runner has 5 credits and the Corp 5.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D. While the Runner approaches Ice Wall the Corp rezzes it. The Runner encounters it and pays 1 credit to break its subroutine with Corroder, passes it, breaches R&D and accesses the top card. The run ends.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by an unrezzed Tollbooth. The Corp has 10 credits and the Runner 5. The Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server. While the Runner approaches Tollbooth the Corp rezzes it. The Runner encounters it and pays 3 credits, breaks nothing, and the subroutine resolves.

expect.why: Tollbooth's toll is paid when the encounter begins.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by an unrezzed Tollbooth. Self-modifying Code is installed and Corroder is in the stack. The Runner has 4 credits and the Corp 10.

steps.label: approach
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server. While the Runner approaches Tollbooth the Corp rezzes it, and the Runner uses Self-modifying Code to find Corroder and install it.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner encounters Tollbooth.

expect.why: 2 for Self-modifying Code and 2 for Corroder.
The Runner cannot pay 3, so Tollbooth ends the run.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by a rezzed Ice Wall. Inside Job is in the grip. The Runner has 5 credits and no icebreaker.

steps.label: bypass
steps.do: The Runner plays Inside Job and runs the remote server. Ice Wall is bypassed and the Runner has passed it.

steps.label: jack-out
steps.do: The Runner jacks out.

expect.why: The subroutine neither resolves nor needs breaking.
The Runner may jack out after passing a piece of ice.
The run did not reach the Success Phase.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by an unrezzed Guard. Inside Job is in the grip. The Corp has 5 credits. The Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Inside Job and runs the remote server. While the Runner approaches Guard the Corp rezzes it. The Runner encounters Guard, breaks nothing, and the subroutine resolves.

expect.why: Guard cannot be bypassed, and 'cannot' wins over Inside Job.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by an unrezzed Tollbooth. Inside Job is in the grip. The Corp has 10 credits and the Runner 5.

steps.label: bypass
steps.do: The Runner plays Inside Job and runs the remote server. While the Runner approaches Tollbooth the Corp rezzes it. Tollbooth is bypassed.

steps.label: jack-out
steps.do: The Runner jacks out.

expect.why: 2 for Inside Job; the toll is not charged.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and is protected by a rezzed Tollbooth (innermost) and an unrezzed Border Control (outermost). The Corp has 10 credits and the Runner 5.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server. While the Runner approaches Border Control the Corp rezzes it and trashes it to end the run.

expect.why: The run ended before Tollbooth was encountered.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server consists only of an unrezzed Ice Wall protecting it; nothing is in its root. Corroder is installed and Knifed is in the grip. The Runner has 5 credits and the Corp 5.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Knifed and runs that server. While the Runner approaches Ice Wall the Corp rezzes it. The Runner encounters it and breaks its subroutine with Corroder. Knifed trashes Ice Wall.

expect.why: The server has no cards left, so it ceases to exist and the run ends.
A run on a server that ceased to exist is neither successful nor unsuccessful.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Susanoo-no-Mikoto is the only ice protecting HQ. A rezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting Archives. The Runner has no icebreaker. (The scenario redirects the run with a test hook; Susanoo-no-Mikoto is the card that does it.)

steps.label: moved
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Susanoo-no-Mikoto and breaks nothing. Its subroutine resolves and the Runner moves to the outermost position of Archives.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the server the run is against. The server the Runner moved to becomes the attacked server.
Not a standard key: the title of the ice being approached. The Runner's position is the outermost ice of Archives and the step is the Approach Ice Phase.

cases.position: As run-timing-redirection-updates-current-ice-5047, with Corroder installed and the Runner at 5 credits.

steps.label: pumped
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Susanoo-no-Mikoto and pays 1 credit for +1 strength on Corroder.

steps.label: next
steps.do: The Runner breaks nothing; the subroutine moves the Runner to the outermost position of Archives. The Runner approaches and then encounters Ice Wall.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the title of the ice being encountered.
The increase lasted for the encounter with Susanoo-no-Mikoto, which has ended.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Account Siphon is in the grip. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Account Siphon. The run is successful and the Runner uses Account Siphon's effect instead of breaching HQ, making the Corp lose 5 credits.

cases.position: As replace-access-you-may-only.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Account Siphon. The run is successful and the Runner chooses to breach HQ, accessing Hedge Fund.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Security Testing is installed and the Runner chose HQ with it when this turn began. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ. The run is successful.

expect.why: The replacement is not optional: the Runner gains 2 credits instead of breaching.

cases.position: Runner's turn. Security Testing is installed and the Runner chose HQ with it when this turn began. Account Siphon is in the grip. HQ has no ice and holds exactly one card, Hedge Fund. The Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Runner plays Account Siphon. The run is successful. The Runner applies Account Siphon's replacement effect and makes the Corp lose 5 credits.

expect.why: Security Testing has nothing left to replace, so its 2 credits are not gained.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Ice Wall is the only ice protecting R&D, an unrezzed Ganked! is in the root of R&D, and the top card of R&D is Hedge Fund. Corroder is installed. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and breaks Ice Wall's subroutine with Corroder. The run is successful. The Runner accesses Ganked! first; the Corp trashes it and chooses Ice Wall, and the Runner encounters Ice Wall.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner breaks the subroutine again. The encounter ends, the Runner accesses the top card of R&D, and the run ends.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the title of the ice being encountered.
After the forced encounter the game returns to the breach and goes on from there.

cases.position: As forced-encounters-forced-encounters-during-run.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and breaks Ice Wall's subroutine with Corroder. The run is successful. The Runner accesses Ganked! first; the Corp trashes it and chooses Ice Wall. In that encounter the Runner breaks nothing and the subroutine ends the run.

expect.why: Ending the run during the forced encounter also ends the breach, so the top card of R&D is not accessed.
The run had reached the Success Phase, so it is not declared unsuccessful.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Konjin is the only ice protecting R&D, an unrezzed Ganked! is in the root of R&D, and the top card of R&D is Hedge Fund. A rezzed Ice Wall protects HQ. The Runner has 5 credits, the Corp 5, and the Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and encounters Konjin; both players bid 0 in the Psi Game. The run is successful. The Runner accesses Ganked! first; the Corp trashes it and chooses Konjin. In that encounter the Corp bids 0 and the Runner 1, and the Corp chooses Ice Wall. The Runner encounters Ice Wall, breaks nothing, and the subroutine ends the run.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server holds PAD Campaign and an unrezzed Ganked! in its root and is protected by a rezzed Ice Wall. Corroder is installed. The Runner has 5 credits.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner runs the remote server and breaks Ice Wall's subroutine with Corroder. The run is successful. The Runner accesses Ganked! first; the Corp trashes it and chooses Ice Wall. In that encounter the Runner breaks nothing and the subroutine ends the run.

expect.why: PAD Campaign is not accessed.

cases.position: As forced-encounters-forced-encounters-during-run, with the Runner at 6 credits.

steps.label: forced
steps.do: The Runner runs R&D and breaks Ice Wall's subroutine with Corroder. The run is successful. The Runner accesses Ganked! first; the Corp trashes it and chooses Ice Wall. In that encounter the Runner pays 1 credit for +1 strength on Corroder and 1 credit to break the subroutine.

steps.label: after
steps.do: The encounter ends and the Runner accesses the top card of R&D.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the number of unbroken subroutines on the ice in this encounter.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server has an unrezzed Ganked! alone in its root and is protected by a rezzed Ice Wall. Corroder and Gordian Blade are installed and Quest Completed is in the grip. The central servers have no ice; HQ and R&D each hold a card and Archives is empty. The Runner has 10 credits.

steps.label: forced
steps.do: The Runner makes a successful run on Archives, on R&D and on HQ, trashing nothing. The Runner then plays Quest Completed and accesses Ganked!; the Corp trashes it and chooses Ice Wall, and the Runner encounters Ice Wall with no run in progress. The Runner pays 1 credit for +1 strength on Corroder, 1 credit to break the subroutine, and 1 credit for +1 strength on Gordian Blade.

steps.label: after
steps.do: The encounter ends.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the title of the ice being encountered.

corrected: CR 3.9.5c's example names this very case: used during an encounter outside a run, Gordian Blade's increase lasts for that encounter. The first reading (2, from CR 9.10.4) is in differences.json.
Read from the turn's record of runs: the three runs were successful, and the forced encounter was not a run, so nothing unsuccessful is recorded.
corrected: added with the line above. The encounter is over, so the increase has ended (CR 3.9.5c).

cases.position: Runner's turn. A remote server has an unrezzed Ganked! alone in its root and is protected by a rezzed Little Engine. Quest Completed is in the grip. The central servers have no ice; HQ and R&D each hold a card and Archives is empty. The Runner has 5 credits and no icebreaker.

steps.label: forced
steps.do: The Runner makes a successful run on Archives, on R&D and on HQ, trashing nothing. The Runner then plays Quest Completed and accesses Ganked!; the Corp trashes it and chooses Little Engine. The Runner encounters it with no run in progress and breaks nothing; the first subroutine resolves.

expect.why: With no run in progress 'End the run.' ends the encounter, so the third subroutine never gives 5 credits.
Not a standard key: the title of the ice being encountered.
Read from the turn's record of runs: the encounter was not a run, so no unsuccessful run is recorded.

cases.skip: The scenario's third part uses Flip Switch's 'Jack out' during a forced encounter with no run in progress. CR 6.1.5 describes jacking out as the Runner ending a run; CR 6.1.4b covers an instruction to end the run during an encounter with no run. Whether a jack out with no run ends the encounter is not settled by the CR, so no outcome is written. It is on the disagreement list (already raised by engine #965).

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Konjin is the only ice protecting HQ, a rezzed Bullfrog the only ice protecting R&D, and a rezzed Ice Wall the only ice protecting Archives. The Runner has 5 credits, the Corp 5, and the Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: moved
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Konjin. The Corp bids 0 and the Runner 1; the Corp chooses Bullfrog and the Runner encounters it, breaking nothing. For Bullfrog's subroutine the Corp spends 0 and the Runner 1, and the Corp moves Bullfrog to the outermost position protecting Archives.

steps.label: next
steps.do: Both encounters end and the run goes on.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the server the run is against. The Runner stays with the encountered ice, and the move changes the underlying run without ending the forced encounter.
Not a standard key: the title of the ice being approached. The run continues from Bullfrog's new position, the outermost of Archives; passing it, the Runner approaches Ice Wall.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Konjin is the only ice protecting HQ and a rezzed Cell Portal the only ice protecting R&D. The Runner has 5 credits, the Corp 5, and the Runner has no icebreaker.

steps.label: portal
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Konjin. The Corp bids 0 and the Runner 1; the Corp chooses Cell Portal and the Runner encounters it, breaking nothing. Its subroutine resolves; the Runner does not jack out.

steps.label: again
steps.do: The run goes on from the outermost position of HQ.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the server the run is against.

Not a standard key: how many Psi Games Konjin has started this run. The Runner was moved to the outermost position of HQ and the step became the Approach Ice Phase, so Konjin is approached and encountered again.

cases.position: As forced-encounters-forced-encounters-redirection, with an unrezzed Ganked! in the root of HQ and HQ holding no cards.

steps.label: moved
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and encounters Konjin; both players bid 0. The run is successful and the Runner accesses Ganked!. The Corp trashes it and chooses Konjin; the Corp bids 0 and the Runner 1, and the Corp chooses Bullfrog. The Runner breaks nothing; for Bullfrog's subroutine the Corp spends 0 and the Runner 1, and the Corp moves Bullfrog to the outermost position protecting Archives.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the server the run is against, or the last one if the run is over. In the Success Phase the Runner has no position and is not moved, so the run stays on HQ.

cases.position: Corp's turn. Unleash is in HQ. An unrezzed Ice Wall protects HQ. The Runner has 1 tag. (The scenario fires the subroutine with a test hook; Unleash is the card that resolves a subroutine outside a run, as in the CR's own example for this rule.)

steps.label: unleash
steps.do: The Corp plays Unleash, removing the tag, rezzes Ice Wall and resolves its 'End the run.' subroutine.

steps.label: run
steps.do: The Corp's turn ends. On the Runner's turn the Runner runs R&D.

expect.why: With neither a run nor an encounter in progress, 'End the run.' does nothing and leaves nothing behind.

cases.skip: The scenario trashes the approached ice with a test hook and names no card that does it. By CR 6.2.7a the approach ends and the run goes on to the Movement Phase; the Runner then approaches the next ice inward and never the ice already passed. No position is built without a card to trash ice during an approach.

cases.position: Runner's turn. HQ is protected by three rezzed pieces of ice: Vanilla (innermost), Ice Wall, and Wall of Static (outermost). Corroder and Arruaceiras Crew are installed. The Runner has 10 credits. (The scenario trashes the ice with a test hook; Arruaceiras Crew is a card that trashes ice during an encounter.)

steps.label: trashed
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, breaks Wall of Static with Corroder (1 credit for strength, 1 to break) and passes it. Encountering Ice Wall, the Runner takes 1 tag with Arruaceiras Crew, then trashes the Crew and pays 2 credits to trash Ice Wall.

steps.label: next
steps.do: The run goes on.

expect.why: Not a standard key: the title of the ice being approached. The encounter ended and the run went to the Movement Phase; the next ice inward is Vanilla, and Wall of Static is not approached again.
Not a standard key: how many times the ice was approached during the run.
